title: Crestline Fleet Account Seasoning and the Balance a Late Charge Applies To
content:
On a Crestline Fleet Account, how the late-charge rate meets the past-due balance depends on the account's seasoning.

## Rule

- For an account approved 60 or more whole months before the day the charge is assessed with at most one late charge assessed less than twelve whole months before it, the balance the rate applies to is the first 1000.00 of the past-due balance plus half of the part above 1000.00.
- For an account approved fewer than 60 whole months before the day the charge is assessed with no late charge assessed less than twelve whole months before it, it is the past-due balance less a 250.00 small-balance allowance, never below 0.00.
- For every other account it is the whole past-due balance.

Seasoning is read from the approval date on the fleet account, counted in whole months, and from the late charge entries in the account's activity dated less than twelve whole months before the day the charge is assessed.

## Combinations

| Approved before the day the charge is assessed | Late charges in the last twelve whole months | Balance the rate applies to |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more whole months | 0 or 1 | first 1000.00, plus half of the part above 1000.00 |
| 60 or more whole months | 2 or more | the whole past-due balance |
| fewer than 60 whole months | 0 | the past-due balance less 250.00, never below 0.00 |
| fewer than 60 whole months | 1 or more | the whole past-due balance |

## Worked figures (hypothetical past-due balances)

- Seasoned account, past-due balance 2400.00: 1000.00 plus half of 1400.00, that is 1700.00.
- Seasoned account, past-due balance 800.00: nothing lies above 1000.00, so 800.00.
- Newer account with no late charge, past-due balance 860.00: 860.00 less 250.00, that is 610.00; with a past-due balance of 180.00 it is 0.00.
